Our Love Story

1

🎓 Where It All Began

Haseena and Adarsh first met at the College of Engineering Trivandrum, when Haseena joined during the second year. There was no instant spark or grand moment—just two people who knew each other as friends, like everyone else. They spoke, worked alongside each other, and went on with college life, never imagining where this would one day lead.

2

💕 Love Found on a Journey

In February 2020, during a college trip, things began to shift. Long journeys and unhurried moments opened space for deeper conversations—about life, society, beliefs, and everything in between. Somewhere in those conversations, Haseena realised she felt something more. She chose honesty over hesitation and shared her feelings, without expectations. A few days later, Adarsh felt it too. What followed wasn’t a dramatic beginning, but a quiet yes—thoughtful, certain, and real.

3

🌍 Love Through Distance

Soon after, life took an unexpected turn, and they found themselves apart for months during covid. With no certainty about when they’d meet again, they built their relationship the way it had begun—through conversations. They spoke about dreams, doubts, choices, and the world around them. As college ended and work took them to different cities, their relationship stayed steady. Friends became family, homes were created in shared moments, and through changing phases of life, they kept choosing each other—calmly, consistently, and with intent.

4

💍 Choosing forever

In February 2022, Haseena asked a simple but powerful question—about marriage, partnership, and a life together. It wasn’t perfect or planned, but it was honest. Adarsh’s answer was an easy yes. Time passed, lives unfolded, families were spoken to, and understanding grew—slowly, patiently, and with courage. In November 2025, surrounded by the people who mattered most, Adarsh asked the question in return. And once again, the answer was an unmistakable yes—to love, to commitment, and to a life built together.

5

🥰 Now

Six years after choosing each other, they’re getting married in February—right where it all began. Not as two people who fell in love suddenly, but as two people who chose love, again and again.
